train_rl_agent: train a reinforcement learning agent with configurable iterations, sampling mode, and evaluation rollouts
load_latest_policy_and_logs: load the latest saved policy and baseline pickle files from a checkpoint directory
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from an existing job folder by loading saved policy and log data
save_policy_and_baseline: save the agent policy and baseline as pickle files at each save frequency interval
evaluate_policy_rollouts: evaluate a trained policy by sampling evaluation rollouts and computing mean reward performance
